reason: The named lab and the batch report on the page are what I always wish other supplements had, and $24.99 for the first box is about 83 cents a day, so it is cheap enough to try once. If I hate it I get my money back, so I am not stuck with another half-used bottle.
objection: Made in China, and I have a drawer full of bottles I stopped using. I want to see that the lab report really matches my batch number before I believe it is tested and not just marketing.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page was missing, did not name the lab, or the batch number did not match the box, I would not buy.
